title: Glazed Tacos with Lacquer-Crusted Chicken
description: Sweet and savory tacos filled with crispy chicken and crunchy toppings. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: glaze
ingredients.notes: mix of honey, soy sauce, and spices

instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. In a shallow dish, mix together glaze and lacquer.
Coat each chicken breast with the lacquer mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Place coated chicken on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through. Let rest for 5 minutes.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by placing a cooked chicken breast on a tortilla, followed by radishes, tomatoes, lettuce, and onions.
Serve immediately, with sour cream on the side (if using).
